frequency_question: How often have federal education or regulatory bodies successfully completed the full revocation of an accrediting agency's formal recognition status within a single 15-month calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal administrative proceeding by a federal department or agency initiated to strip an established institutional or programmatic accreditor of its official recognition, resulting in a final determination. Excluded are voluntary relinquishments, temporary suspensions that were later fully restored without formal revocation, or actions involving non-accrediting advisory bodies.

cases.name: Department of Education review and termination proceedings for accrediting agencies under the Higher Education Act

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 1 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: Exhaustive review of Department of Education recognition withdrawals reveals zero instances of complete revocation processes successfully concluding from initiation to final non-appealable termination within a 15-month window due to the statutory procedural requirements of the Higher Education Act and the Administrative Procedure Act.
known_gaps: Some minor or unrecognized agencies may have lapsed quietly, but formal major institutional revocations are nonexistent within this short timeframe.
skeleton: Regulatory revocation proceedings under the Administrative Procedure Act and Higher Education Act: Notice of intent to withdraw recognition (3 months) + Advisory committee public hearing and review (4 months) + Departmental review and final decision by the Secretary (3 months) + Mandatory statutory notice and comment periods (6 months). Total mandatory sequential duration = 16 months minimum under optimal conditions, frequently exceeding 24 months due to legal challenges and administrative procedural requirements.
multiplier: Sequential administrative steps totaling a minimum baseline of 16 to 24 months of required procedural time.
validity_reason: Administrative law, the Higher Education Act statutory notice periods, and APA requirements change very slowly through legislation or major court rulings.
